---
title: "FesmData"
subtitle: "Processed datasets for ice-sheet and Earth-system models, on the grids of each model domain"
---

FesmData produces datasets for models, such as topography, region masks, geothermal heat
flow or surface mass balance, on the grids of each model domain, from the base grid
(25 m to 2 km) to 32 km, and on global lon-lat grids. Each is made from the original
sources, with every step in the [repository](https://github.com/fesmc/FesmData), and
released on
[Helmholtz Codebase](https://codebase.helmholtz.cloud/fesmc/fesmdata-products/-/packages),
one package per domain, dataset and grid, versioned by the release; releases can also
be archived on [Zenodo](https://zenodo.org/communities/fesmc) with a DOI.

- [Datasets](datasets.qmd): what each dataset contains, its sources and licences, and
  its files; [Records](records_overview.qmd) for the non-gridded data.
- [Products](products.qmd): which dataset is released on which domain.
- [Domains and grids](domains.qmd): the model domains, their grids and grid files.
- [Download](download.qmd): how to get the files.
- [Your own data](remap.qmd): put any gridded dataset onto the same grids.

## Getting started

With [Julia](https://julialang.org/downloads/) installed (no packages needed):

```bash
git clone https://github.com/fesmc/FesmData.git
cd FesmData
export FESMDATA=/path/to/fesmdata          # where the files go
julia fesmdata.jl list Topo                # where Topo is released
julia fesmdata.jl fetch Topo ANT-8KM       # Topo on the 8 km grid of Antarctica
```

The files land in `$FESMDATA/Antarctica/ANT-8KM/`, with the grid files. See
[Download](download.qmd) for the details.
